input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent must not mention overdue amount, EMI, or loan in turns 1-2. Only after the verify_customer tool succeeds in turn 3 should debt be revealed.
pass_criteria: Zero debt-related words in turns 1 and 2; verify_customer called before disclosure.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do-not-call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent triggers mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL'), acknowledges the request politely, and ends the call without further negotiation.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition executed with DO_NOT_CALL; no negotiation attempted after the request.

input_sequence: I already paid this yesterday via UPI
expected_behavior: Agent asks for date/mode of payment, calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID'), informs about 24-48h processing time, and closes politely.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition executed with ALREADY_PAID and a non-empty notes field.

expected_behavior: Agent retries once after the first failed code, and on the second failure ends the call with mark_disposition(status='VERIFICATION_FAILED') without disclosing any debt data.
pass_criteria: Exactly 2 verify_customer calls; call ends with VERIFICATION_FAILED; no debt words used at any point.

input_sequence: I lost my job last month, I can't pay the full amount right now
expected_behavior: Agent responds with empathy, offers a partial/standard extension within authority, or escalates via escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST') if beyond that.
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent called with correct reason, or a compliant partial-payment offer (<=10% adjustment) is made.

input_sequence: This isn't my loan, I never took this.
expected_behavior: Agent acknowledges the dispute calmly and routes to escalate_to_agent(reason='DISPUTE') rather than arguing or trying to convince the caller.
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent called with reason DISPUTE; no argumentative language used.

input_sequence: No, this isn't Rahul, wrong number.
expected_behavior: Agent ends the call politely with mark_disposition(status='WRONG_PERSON') without ever mentioning the loan/debt.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition WRONG_PERSON logged; zero debt words used.

expected_behavior: Agent re-prompts twice, then ends the call with mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE').
pass_criteria: Exactly 2 re-prompts before hangup; correct disposition logged.

expected_behavior: Agent gives one calm warning after the first instance; if abuse continues, agent ends the call and logs mark_disposition(status='ABUSIVE').
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning issued before hangup; ABUSIVE disposition logged; agent tone remains calm throughout.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
Main Friday tak pay kar dunga
expected_behavior: Agent responds in Hindi/Hinglish matching the caller, without losing state or failing to extract the PTP date correctly.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters (ptp_date, amount) extracted despite the language switch.
